The structure of Li4Al4H8O16 (reduced formula LiAl(HO2)2) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 32 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Al and Li each adopt octahedral environments with six O neighbors, while H is coordinated by two O neighbors. Corner-sharing between Al and Li octahedra and edge-sharing between like octahedra are observed, forming a three-dimensional periodic connectivity network.
